context.data_run_id: agent_run and tool_execution data.run_id must equal context.run_id

generation: Spindle authenticated g3 nonce, expiration and HMAC-SHA256 lease; ordered sequences starting at 1
data: fabrico11y/2 data variants and bounds unchanged
custody: preserve original bytes; local receipt differs from canonical receipt

attributes.brief: Globally unique nonzero lowercase UUID, carried unchanged across processes and origins.
attributes.name: fabric.context.run_id
attributes.note: Required in the v3 context object. AgentRun and ToolExecution data.run_id must equal this value. V2 local run names remain namespaced by origin, producer and generation and do not imply global correlation.

semantics.brief: Observation envelope extension for cross-process run correlation.
semantics.note: All data variants, discriminator values, field bounds and unsigned nanosecond arithmetic retain the immutable fabrico11y/2 definitions. No new data enums are introduced.

attributes.brief: Spindle-issued opaque g3 generation lease in the observation identity; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes.
attributes.name: fabric.generation
attributes.note: The token carries a random nonce, expiration and HMAC-SHA256 authentication bound to the producer. Per-generation sequences start at one and advance in order. Memory acceptance, local custody and canonical Fabric custody are distinct acknowledgements.

attributes.brief: Unsigned expiration timestamp in Unix seconds returned by lease control; normally issued for 86400 seconds.
attributes.name: fabric.lease.expires_unix_s
attributes.note: This is control-plane metadata, not a new observation field or an OpenTelemetry signed-integer wire conversion. The authenticated expiration is also encoded in the opaque generation string.

semantics.brief: Authenticated generation lease control metadata; not additional observation data fields.
semantics.note: Spindle authenticates issued generations with HMAC-SHA256. Expiration remains detectable after generation metadata reclamation. Expired generations refuse new admission and retries, while sealed pending records remain retained and forwardable. Renewal requires a quiescent client; clocks behind the persisted floor fail closed.
